scope: Actual full-app global hotkey path inside Windows Sandbox. SendInput OS events, not a hardware keyboard.
aspect_ratio_policy: Source fits inside each viewport with neutral padding; no stretching.
timeline: Causal sampling of original VFR timestamps at 1x. Camera continues 100 ms after its own observed endpoint, then holds that captured frame. No pre-result delay or motion interpolation.
static_details: Only post-response context: genuine captured toolbar photo or actual product-saved PNG, labelled separately from source video.
notification_note: Zipshot marks its toast WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE. File-readiness timing does not depend on toast visibility, and the PNG preview is an actual saved file, not a reconstructed notification.

app_runs.selection: Median of its own 3 recorded valid trials; no best-case selection.
app_runs.decoded_buffer_timeline: Untimed RGB buffers; displayed positions use original source PTS, including ties.
